flags.why: Cảm nghĩ denotes thoughts or feelings, not the act of pondering, so this verb sense teaches an invalid usage ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-cảm%20nghĩ)).
The common meaning of urging someone to act faster is missing and is not restricted to requesting payment ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-thúc)).
flags.fix: Add: verb | to urge; to hurry someone along. Example: Mẹ cứ thúc tôi đi nhanh lên. = Mom kept urging me to hurry up.
